full_details: Nick tried the mended vowel and did not swallow the noun to reach the rhyme. Nobody spoke a line of French that was not already mended, and nobody spoke the verse of the old duke. At dinner the loaf was still a finger and a half short of the notch, at a penny, and it was not set on a pan. After the afternoon's play Kemp was told the slippers are Thursday. At night the uncles were still the uncles. Act 3 was not opened, and the England speech was not written.
one_sentence: The comedy came back from Blackfriars with two words mended, you ate a loaf a finger and a half short, and the jig waited.
title: The book back, and a short loaf
